dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, the temple is across the street. Let's go!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ðə ˈtɛmpəl ɪz əˈkrɔːs ðə ˈstriːt. ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Stop! Don't cross here. The traffic light is red.
dialogue.reading: ˈstɑːp! ˈdoʊnt ˈkrɔːs ˈhɪr. ðə ˈtræfɪk ˌlaɪt ɪz ˈrɛd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Be careful, Emma. OK, it's green now. Let's go!
dialogue.reading: bi ˈkɛrfəl, ˈɛmə. oʊˈkeɪ, ɪts ˈɡriːn ˈnaʊ. ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ!
